environment.description: NestJS microservice deployed on EKS behind an AWS ALB with standard HTTPS listener (TLS termination at ALB). Ingress configured with `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internet-facing` and `alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTPS":443}]'`. Service is accessible to any client that can reach the ALB endpoint. No XML-specific request filtering. Node.js 18 runtime with libxmljs2 v0.33.0.
